anatomy.geometry_scope: Inferred optic-column coordinates, not measured optical axes or 3D eye coordinates
anatomy.side_rule: somaSide when L/R, otherwise rootSide; photoreceptors use rootSide

interpretation: Descriptive model responses, not physiological recordings or a learning comparison. No topology changes, optimizer updates, or final-test selection. Absolute response amplitudes accompany correlations. Jitter preserves signs and destination incoming mass; input and head seed stay fixed. Existing overlays retain random feature channels and unqualified photoreceptor assignments. Do not freeze action groups from these pilots before biological input alignment.

probes.rule: One unaugmented position per distinct training opening family; no target-based selection
